articles.summary: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd (Credo) (NASDAQ: CRDO), an innovator in providing connectivity at scale through fast, reliable, and energy-efficient system solutions, will showcase its newest optical and copper interconnect products for scaling AI infrastructure at AI Infra Summit 2026. AI Infra Summit 2026 takes place September 15-17 at the Santa Clara Convention Center in Santa Clara, California. articles.title: Credo to Showcase High-Speed Connectivity Innovations Driving Next-Generation AI Infrastructure at AI Infra 2026
